title: Đâu, luôn, chứ, mà: emphasis and soft negation

vocab.en: not at all, not really (soft negation, paired with không...đâu — a different job from đâu = where)
but really, though (softly contradicts or reassures)

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say the generic counting word —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: cái] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say glass —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ly] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say bottle —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chai] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say bowl —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: tô] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say loaf —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ổ] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say person, as a measure word —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: người] [EN: Good.]

Today it works differently. Paired with] [VI: không] [EN: at the start and] [VI: đâu] [EN: at the end, it makes a soft, friendly no — not at all.
